scope: Final artifacts only; original evaluator verdict copied without rerun. No record/samples/captures/maps read.

grab.sensor_rule: First holding request strictly after this command and before the next grab/release in public bridge order; no fallback across that boundary.

release.sensor_rule: First holding request strictly after this command and before the next grab/release in public bridge order; no fallback across that boundary.

state_count_semantics: Distinct WM IDs, not distinct physical balls; evaluator owns physical identity/delivery counts.

historical_view_revisit.semantics: Available capability is not a selected revisit. Navigation identity groups are observed aliases, not extra truth balls.
